scientific_integrity: The cut variational principle and graphical-zonotope definitions are credited to existing work. All statements are supported by a self-contained proof; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns unweighted simple cycles with all leaves at one hub; it does not classify general unicyclic or weighted graphs. Exact cut enumeration is finite corroboration, not an infinite proof. Historical priority remains provisional, particularly because the closely related universal cut-expansion record was accessible only in indexed-summary form.
title: Sharp Euclidean width transitions for cycle–star graphical zonotopes
